# Third-party audio (CC0)

Demo board samples under [`Audio/`](Audio/) are converted (OGG/MP3 → MP3) from
[Kenney.nl](https://kenney.nl) packs published as **CC0 1.0** (public domain).

Attribution is appreciated but **not required**:

- [Interface Sounds](https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds) — via [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/interface-sounds)
- [Sci-Fi Sounds](https://kenney.nl/assets/sci-fi-sounds) — via [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-sounds)
- [Digital sound effects](https://opengameart.org/content/63-digital-sound-effects-lasers-phasers-space-etc)
- [50 RPG sound effects](https://opengameart.org/content/50-rpg-sound-effects)

See `LICENSE-*.txt` / `README-digital.txt` copied from those packs.

Support Kenney: https://kenney.nl/donate
